reason: A prohibited item-modification-after-modification boundary was crossed: the conversation explicitly states that after modifying items, the agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore, yet the assistant then performed an address modification on the same order. This is a direct violation of the written prohibition on further modification after item modification. The item-change itself also involved choosing a new backpack variant of the same product type, so the main issue is the second update after item modification.
